prompts.title: Recent Form — Kinetic Rhythm
prompts.prompt:
Vertical 9:16 stage on GoatLab charcoal #101412 with the lower quarter permanently reserved for yellow subtitles; keep all content inside the upper three quarters. Two variants, editorial first.

Editorial variant — kinetic typography: Stage 1, the Spanish heading 'ÚLTIMOS PARTIDOS' lands top-centre in condensed warm white #edf0e6 capitals, each word hitting on the narration beat with a two-frame overshoot. Stage 2, 'Sporting Clube de Portugal' sweeps in from the left edge in lime #c5ed74 while 'LASK Linz' sweeps in from the right edge in slate #8ca6bf, meeting a hairline centre divider that flickers once. Stage 3, rhythmic emphasis: the Spanish words 'INVICTO' and 'RACHA' pulse in scale on alternating beats, each pulse emitting a soft charcoal shockwave ring behind the type. No axes, no figures, no sample claims and no depicted match events; pure typographic rhythm. Camera: a slow push-in covering one tenth of frame height across the scene.

Statistical variant — grouped count bars on a shared zero baseline: two clusters labelled 'Sporting Clube de Portugal' and 'LASK Linz', each with three bars for 'Victorias', 'Empates' and 'Derrotas', all in the single unit 'partidos' on one common scale sized to the tallest bar. Bars rise in a staggered six-frame cascade, Sporting in lime, LASK in slate, warm-white value labels resolved from {{home.wins}}, {{home.draws}}, {{home.losses}}, {{away.wins}}, {{away.draws}} and {{away.losses}}. Attach the sample to each cluster — 'muestra: {{home.n}} partidos' and 'muestra: {{away.n}} partidos' — so unequal samples would be immediately visible; here both annotations read alike. Place the source line 'Fuente: Bzzoiro' in small slate type above the subtitle band. Emphasis: the tallest bar receives a single lime outline pulse. Exit: bars retract into the baseline and a twelve-frame crossfade transition hands over to the next scene. Maintain one focal point per stage and Spanish labels legible at mobile size.
